# 2025 Hawaii Rainbow Warriors football team

The 2025 Hawaii Rainbow Warriors football team will represent the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa in the Mountain West Conference during the 2025 NCAA Division I FBS football season. The Rainbow Warriors will be led by Timmy Chang in his fourth year as the program's head coach. The Rainbow Warriors will play home games at the Clarence T. C. Ching Athletics Complex, located in Honolulu, Hawaii.
